Title: News From the Liaison: WotC Looking for Artists

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
For immediate release.

Charles Keith-Stanley
Cyberspace Liaison
Wizards of the Coast
were...@wizards.com
lia...@wizards.com

------------------------------------------------

DECKMASTER ARTIST GUIDELINES

What We're Looking For

Wizards of the Coast is looking for artists with a unique style that
represents the world of Magic: The Gathering, Vampire and Netrunner.
Skillful use of your chosen medium in combination with imaginative
concepts is desired. The ability to skillfully render the human anatomy
is also strongly desired.

Submission Guidelines

Submissions should consist of 6 to 10 finished full color pieces. These
can be in the form of slides, photographs, tear sheets or samples. No
original art work please. If you are submitting art work in the form of
color copies, send high quality copies only. Also include a cover
letter with a telephone number and a SASE. Including a resume is optional.

Sending Submissions

Magic and Vampire submissions should be sent to the attention of Sandra
Everingham and Netrunner submissions to the attention of Christopher Rush
at the following address:

Wizards of the Coast
PO Box 707
Renton, WA 98057

For questions, call Sandra Everingham or Chris Rush at (206) 226-6500.

Messages.Author: Jeremy York
Messages.Body:
Dr. Mosh (drk...@netcom.com) wrote:
: ARTIST'S UNWRITTEN GUIDLINE
: ===============================
: No Pentagrams,

Seems to be true.

: no demons, no ghosts, nothing that looks like

: a demon, no horns, no fangs, no teeth, no skin, no red eyes, no yellow eyes,
: no forked tongues, no tails, no goatees, no fire, no flames,

Charnas the Imp? Lord of the Pit? Any number of vampire cards?

: no stars,

: no dark paintings, the color black or dark red or red is not allowed, no
: knives, sharp objects, or pointy objects, no wheels, no forks, no splits in
: the road, no measures of balances, no no no no no!

Sorry to belabor the obvious, but you are *really* exxagerating here.
WotC has said that the Jyhad art won't be changing; and in the new
magic, they buckled on a couple of cards (really, only Demonic Hordes
and Unholy strength - I think the black Ante cards were doomed anyway) but also
left in much that might be considered offensive.

They've given an inch - so if you think that's bad, post about how it's
a slippery slope, that soon anything cutting will be eliminated from
the art...but there's no point in exxagerating what's been done
recently - it's only 2 (or 4 depending on how you count it) cards out
of a large set of cards. And Jyhad, uh, I mean, Vampire : the Eternal
Struggle isn't being watered down art-wise, so they say.
--
Jeremy (bea...@netcom.com, bea...@delphi.com)
